newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 27.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The first comprehensive nationwide study of standards among 7 year olds has shown that in London primary schools youngsters are trailing in reading, spelling and maths. Thousands of primary school children after two years at school are shown to have the reading ability of pre school children.
STERLING SET TO CASH IN ON EMU TENSIONS
If Franco-German tensions rise to the surface at today's meeting of European Union finance ministers in Brussels, sterling could regain some of the losses it made last week on foreign exchanges.
BIOTECH DUO BOUND FOR THE STOCK MARKET

Renewed confidence in the biotecnology sector has been sparked by two Cambridge-based firms set to join the stock market. Cambridge Antibody Technology Group plans a full listing on the stock exchange before the summer. Cambridge Bioscience Innovation Centre aims to raise up to six million stg on the Alternative Investment Market.
SOUTH KOREA ORDERS HANBO STEEL PROBE
The President of South Korea has ordered a government inquiry into the collapse of the flagship unit of the Hanbo Group, Hanbo Steel Industry.
